name: Agent_4
profile:

reward_history.explanation: The Trustee returned only 10 coins out of 21 received (47.6% return rate), which is below the break-even threshold for the Trustor. The Trustee kept 11 coins (52% of the multiplied amount), demonstrating moderate trustworthiness at best. Since the Trustee knew this reward opportunity existed and still chose a below-average return rate, no reward is warranted. The Trustee's behavior does not merit personal costly punishment, but it also does not deserve costly positive reinforcement.
